Corporate Profile


華潤醫藥集團有限公司（股份代號：3320）是中                China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Limited (stock code: 3320) is a leading
國領先的綜合醫藥公司，業務範疇覆蓋醫藥及                   integrated pharmaceutical company in China. Our business encompasses
保 健 產 品 的 生 產、分 銷 及 零 售。本 集 團 成 立 於    manufacturing, distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and healthcare
二零零七年，現已發展成中國前兩大醫藥製造                   products. Since the establishment in 2007, the Group has developed into
商兼中國前三大醫藥產品分銷商（按收益）。                   one of the top 2 pharmaceutical manufacturers and one of the top 3
                                       pharmaceutical distributors (by revenue) in China.

本公司於二零一六年十月在香港成功完成全球                   In October 2016, the Company successfully completed its global offering
發 售。我 們 的 製 造 業 務 涵 蓋 研 發、生 產 及 銷 售    in Hong Kong. Our manufacturing business encompasses the research and
醫 藥 及 保 健 產 品。我 們 生 產 840 種 產 品，其 中    development, manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical and healthcare
439 種產品進入了國家醫保目錄。產品組合包括                products. We manufacture 840 products, 439 of which were included in the

廣 泛 治 療 領 域，包 括 心 血 管、消 化 道 和 新 陳 代    drugs, Chinese medicines and biological drugs as well as nutritional and

董事會會議                                 Board Meetings
董事會每年召開至少四次董事會定期會議，大                  The Board meets regularly and at least four times a year at approximately
約 每 季 一 次。有 關 董 事 會 的 定 期 會 議，董 事 一   quarterly intervals. With respect to regular meetings of the Board, Directors

董事均獲機會出席定期會議並討論議程事項。                  provide all Directors with an opportunity to attend and include matters in the
                                      agenda for a regular meeting.

就其他董事會及董事會委員會會議而言，本公                  For other Board and Board Committee meetings, reasonable notice is
司會發出合理通知。會議議程及相關董事會文                  generally given. The agenda and accompanying Board papers are dispatched
件會至少在舉行會議日期的五天前送出，以確                  to the Directors at least five days before the meetings to ensure that they
保董事有充足時間審閱有關文件及充分準備出                  have sufficient time to review the papers and are adequately prepared for
席會議。倘董事或董事會委員會成員未能出席                  the meetings. When the Directors or Board Committee members are unable
會議，則彼等會獲悉將予討論的事宜及於會議                  to attend a meeting, they will be advised of the matters to be discussed and
召開前有機會知會董事會主席或相關董事會委                  given an opportunity to make their views known to the Chairman of the
員會主席有關彼等的意見。                          Board or the relevant chairman of the Board Committee prior to the meeting.

董事提名政策概要                                   Summary of the Director Nomination Policy
本公司了解及認同董事會具備適當的所需技巧、                      The Company recognizes and embraces the benefits of a Board with a balance
經驗及多樣的觀點與角度的裨益，考慮到提名                       of skills, experience and diversity of perspectives. Given the importance of the
委員會在其中所扮演的重要角色，為提高有關                       Nomination Committee’s role in ensuring the balance within the Board and
提名委員會就有關選舉董事的透明度及問責，                       to give greater focus and transparency in relation to the election of Directors,
本公司就此制定董事提名政策，旨在列出提名                       the Company has established the Director Nomination Policy. This policy aims
委員會在甄選、委任及再度委任董事方面的方                       to set out the approach to guide the Nomination Committee in relation to the
針，及確保董事會在技能、經驗、知識及多元化                      selection, appointment and re-appointment of the Directors, and to ensure
觀點方面取得平衡，切合本公司的業務要求。                       the Board has a balance of skills experience, knowledge and diversity of
                                           perspectives appropriate to the requirements of the Company’s business.

根 據 公 司 條 例 第 566 條，如 本 公 司 收 到 佔 全 體      In accordance with Section 566 of the Companies Ordinance, the Directors
有權在股東大會上表決的股東的總表決權最                        are required to call a general meeting if the Company has received requests
少 5% 的 本 公 司 股 東 的 要 求，要 求 召 開 股 東 大       to do so from members of the Company representing at least 5% of the total
會，則 董 事 須 召 開 股 東 大 會。該 要 求 (a) 須 述        voting rights of all the members having a right to vote at general meeting.
明有待在有關股東大會上處理的事務的一般性                       Such requests (a) must state the general nature of the business to be dealt
